question: What is the total net revenue per market segment?
SQL: SELECT c.c_mktsegment, ROUND(SUM(l.l_net_revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

question: Which nations have the highest number of customers?
SQL: SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(*) AS num_customers FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY num_customers DESC LIMIT 10

question: What is the average discount applied per supplier nation?
SQL: SELECT n.n_name, ROUND(AVG(l.l_discount), 4) AS avg_discount FROM lineitem l JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY avg_discount DESC

question: List the top 10 suppliers by total quantity supplied.
SQL: SELECT s.s_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_qty FROM supplier s JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 10

question: What is the total revenue by order quarter?
SQL: SELECT o.o_quarter, ROUND(SUM(l.l_net_revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_quarter ORDER BY o.o_quarter

question: Which part types generate the most revenue?
SQL: SELECT p.p_type, ROUND(SUM(l.l_net_revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_type ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10

question: How many orders are in each order priority level?
SQL: SELECT o_orderpriority, COUNT(*) AS num_orders FROM orders GROUP BY o_orderpriority ORDER BY num_orders DESC

question: What is the average order value per customer balance tier?
SQL: SELECT c.c_has_debt, ROUND(AVG(o.o_totalprice), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_has_debt ORDER BY c.c_has_debt

question: Which regions have the highest total lineitem quantity?
SQL: SELECT r.r_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_qty FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_qty DESC

question: What is the total value of returned items per return flag?
SQL: SELECT l_returnflag, ROUND(SUM(l_net_revenue), 2) AS total_value FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_returnflag ORDER BY total_value DESC
